description: Returns where the New Covenant (New Testament) quotes the Tanakh, in either direction: give a New Covenant book, chapter or verse for the Tanakh (Old Testament) passages it quotes, or a Tanakh one for the New Covenant passages that quote it. Each result carries both English texts and a link; 15 per page by default (limit 1-40, and nextOffset continues). Use when the user asks where the New Covenant (New Testament) quotes the Tanakh (Old Testament), or the reverse.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-40, default 15)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

offset.description: how many results to skip; the previous answer's nextOffset is where its page ended

name: get_quotations
title: New Covenant (New Testament) quotations
